# BhoomiMitra (भू-मित्र) — Direct Land & Plot Marketplace

> BhoomiMitra is India's direct-to-owner land and agricultural plot classifieds platform, facilitating direct connection between landowners and prospective buyers with 0% brokerage commissions, transparent document disclosure, interactive satellite maps, and a flat advertising fee model.

BhoomiMitra operates a direct peer-to-peer classifieds marketplace covering Indian landowners, agricultural buyers, residential plot buyers, and commercial land investors across all 28 states and 8 union territories. Core value propositions include 0% broker commission, direct landowner listings, transparent seller-provided document disclosure, and interactive Google Satellite property boundary viewing.

Indian Land Measurement Conversions:
- 1 Square Yard = 1 sq. yd (9 sq. ft)
- 1 Gunta = 121 sq. yds
- 1 Cent = 48.4 sq. yds
- 1 Acre = 4,840 sq. yds (40 Guntas / 100 Cents)
- 1 Hectare = 11,959.9 sq. yds (2.471 Acres)

## Key Public Routes

- [Marketplace Homepage](https://bhoomimitra.com/): Multi-attribute search and featured land classifieds.
- [Find Land & Properties](https://bhoomimitra.com/buy): Interactive land explorer with price sliders, unit conversions, and location filters.
- [List Your Land](https://bhoomimitra.com/sell): Multi-step land listing creator with seller legal declarations and instant publishing upon payment.
- [Advertising Pricing](https://bhoomimitra.com/pricing): Platform advertising pricing (Flat ₹10-₹25 for 30-day listing subscriptions).
- [About BhoomiMitra](https://bhoomimitra.com/about): Mission, transparency policies, and zero-brokerage classifieds model.
- [Customer Support](https://bhoomimitra.com/contact): Customer support desk and listing grievance redressal team.
- [Listing Rules](https://bhoomimitra.com/listing-rules): Standards for seller submissions, legal declarations, and prohibited listings.
